background: Cumberland Building Society is a regional mutual based in Carlisle, funded by retail savings from its branch network across Cumbria and neighbouring counties and lending on residential mortgages and to holiday-let and hospitality businesses.
synthesis: None of the three main agencies rates the society, so the case rests on its own figures. Capital is solid, with CET1 of 16.6% just above the UK building society median and leverage of 6.8% in the top quarter, and liquidity is comfortable, with LCR of 195% and NSFR of 151% both above the median. The trend is the weak spot: CET1 has fallen 3.8 points and LCR 73 points since 31 Mar 2022, though leverage and NSFR have risen over longer runs (figures to 31 Mar 2026).
